bibl.seg: Deborah Steiner, Harmonic Divergence: Pindar's Fr. 140B and Early Fifth-Century Choral Polemics.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. III, 408 = P. Yale I, 18 (= MP3 1373; LDAB 3708). - 1. Xenocritus of Locri (lines 1-11). - 2. Pindaric multiplicity and musical polemics (lines 11-17). - 3. Generic concerns: between paean and dithyramb.
